name: SVC_WORK_ORDERS_
description: This table is used to store field service work orders created by users. WO_ID is primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: WO_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the work order is active (Y or N), based on the value of work order status category.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party ID of the user who created this Work order.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Source code that indicates how the work order was last updated such as AGENT_UI, OFSC or API.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WO_NUMBER
columns.description: Auto-generated unique number with customizable format.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: A brief title of the work order.

columns.name: WO_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_WO_TYPE_MAP (WO_TYPE_ID), the customizable type of the work order.

columns.name: WO_STATUS_MAP_ID
columns.description: Stores the Status Map ID of the work order. This column is used for Elastic Search.

columns.name: PARTNER_ACCOUNT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The id of the partner account for this work order. This is a foreign key reference to HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID).

columns.name: WO_STATUS_CAT_CD
columns.description: Lookup code indicating the current life-cycle status category of the work order.

columns.name: WO_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Lookup code indicating the current life-cycle status of the work order.

columns.name: WO_INTEGRATION_CD
columns.description: Work order integration code to represent the current integration state of the work order.

columns.name: WO_INTEGRATION_MSG_CD
columns.description: Message code used to show user friendly error messages and provide general information to fix the issue.

columns.name: WO_INTEGRATION_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Work Order integration status to represent the state of the Work Order in the life cycle.

columns.name: SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates how the WO was entered into the system, such as AGENT_UI, CUSTOMER_UI, API.  Based on ORA_SVC_SOURCE_CD lookup type.

columns.name: SR_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key referencing SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS (SR_ID), the SR associated to the work order.

columns.name: OPPORTUNITY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key referencing MOO_OPTY (OPTY_ID), the Opportunity associated to the work order.

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of owner who is receiving service for this work order, such as CUSTOMER or PARTNER.

columns.name: PRIMARY_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Indicates the primary asset for the Work Order if there are multiple assets associated to the Work Order.  This is a Foreign Key referencing ZCA_ASSET (ASSET_ID).

columns.name: ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the resource who is assigned to work on the Work Order.  This is a Foreign Key reference to HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID).

columns.name: REQUESTED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person who requested the Work Order.  This is a Foreign Key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID).

columns.name: ACCOUNT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key referencing HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Account for this work order.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Contact for this work order.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: The ID of the work order party site where the service will be performed. This is a foreign key reference to HZ_PARTY_SITES (PARTY_SITE_ID).

columns.name: CONTACT_NAME
columns.description: Work order specific contact name of the customer.

columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL
columns.description: Work order specific email for the customer contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Work order specific phone number of the customer contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_ALT_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Work order specific alternate phone number of the customer contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: The language code of the work order location of the customer.

columns.name: ADDRESS_SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code used to indicate the source of the address information.

columns.name: ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: The id of the work order address where the service will be performed. This is a foreign key reference to HZ_LOCATIONS (LOCATION_ID).

columns.name: ADDRESS1
columns.description: Work order specific address line 1, where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS2
columns.description: Work order specific address line 2, where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS3
columns.description: Work order specific address line 3, where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS4
columns.description: Work order specific address line 4, where the service will be performed.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: Work order specific city where the service will be performed.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: Work order specific county where the service will be performed.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Work order specific postal code where the service will be performed.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: Work order specific state where the service will be performed.

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: Work order specific province where the service will be performed.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Work order specific country where the service will be performed.

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: The timezone code of the work order specific address where the service will be performed.

columns.name: WO_AREA
columns.description: The work order location of the customer.

columns.name: CASE_NOTE
columns.description: A note field to contain any useful information which pertains to the work order as entered by service agents.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: The manual duration value documenting the expected time to complete the work order.

columns.name: REMINDER_TIME
columns.description: A time  in minutes before the scheduled time slot when a reminder will be given to the field service tech in OFSC.

columns.name: RESOLUTION_DUE_DATE
columns.description: The resolution due date based based on customers service level agreement (SLA).

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE
columns.description: The requested date of the work order, no time component.

columns.name: REQUESTED_TIME_SLOT
columns.description: The requested time slot for the work order.

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE_START_TIME
columns.description: The requested date and start time of the work order.

columns.name: REQUESTED_DATE_END_TIME
columns.description: The requested date and end time of the work order.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_DATE
columns.description: The scheduled date of the work order.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_TIME_SLOT
columns.description: The scheduled time slot for the work order.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_DATE_START_TIME
columns.description: The scheduled date and start time of the work order.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_DATE_END_TIME
columns.description: The scheduled date and end time of the work order.

columns.name: FS_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The integration Activity ID of the work order, used for data synchronization.

columns.name: FS_ERROR_DETAIL
columns.description: Field Service Integration error message details.

columns.name: FS_NOTE
columns.description: A note field to contain any useful information which pertains to the work order dispatch or scheduling comments.

columns.name: FIELD_SERVICE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: The resource being used to complete this work order. This is a foreign key reference to HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID).

columns.name: FS_SCHED_RESOURCE_EXT_ID
columns.description: The external ID of the scheduled resource being used to complete this work order.

columns.name: FS_RESOURCE
columns.description: The resource being used to complete this work order.

columns.name: FS_SCHED_RESOURCE
columns.description: The scheduled resource being used to complete this work order.

columns.name: FS_CONTACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the contact came from integrating system.

columns.name: TRAVEL_TIME
columns.description: The time in minutes the field service agent is expected to travel to arrive at the work order destination.

columns.name: BOOKED_DATE
columns.description: The actual booked date of the scheduled date and time slot of the work order.

columns.name: ACTUAL_START_DATE
columns.description: The actual start date of the work at the customer location.

columns.name: ACTUAL_END_DATE
columns.description: The actual end date of the work completed at the customer location.

columns.name: DELIVERY_WIN_START_DATE
columns.description: An estimated delivery window start time for the pending work.

columns.name: DELIVERY_WIN_END_DATE
columns.description: An estimated delivery window end time for the pending work.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_START_DATE
columns.description: The estimated expected time of arrival of the field service tech at the customer location.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Lookup code used to indicate the status of an override request.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_REASON
columns.description: A brief description of the reason for requesting an override on the time slot scheduled.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the user who handled the override request.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON
columns.description: A brief description of the reason for cancelling the work order.

columns.name: RESCHEDULE_REASON
columns.description: A brief description of the reason for rescheduling the work order time slot.

columns.name: ACC_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_FS_ACCESS_SCHEDULES (ACC_SCHEDULE_ID), the last used Access Schedule for this work order.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the work order is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID

columns.name: IB_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Install base asset, if any: Optional foreign key to CSE_ASSETS_B.ASSET_ID

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the product associated with the work order.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the organization of the product that is associated with the work order.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B (PROD_GROUP_ID), the unique identifier of the product group associated with the work order.

columns.name: FS_RESOURCE_EXT_ID
columns.description: The external ID of the resource being used to complete this work order.

columns.name: WO_PARENT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the parent work order. This is a foreign key reference to SVC_WORK_ORDERS (WO_ID).

columns.name: FS_TECHNICIAN_LOCATOR_URL

columns.name: WO_RECORD_TYPE
